Overview:

A sheltered young man falls for the woman next door - older, married, and haunted by a past she can't escape. As friendship blurs into forbidden desire, every stolen moment draws them deeper. A mature visual novel about temptation, guilt, and the danger of feeling truly alive.​

Developer Notes:

Спойлер

FORBIDDEN GROUND

Eric (customizable name) has spent his whole life on the sidelines - caring for his mother, hiding in books, watching the world from a safe distance. Then he meets the woman next door.

Jennifer Morrison is older. She's married. And she's the most alive thing that has ever happened to him.

What starts as running lessons and quiet afternoons over books becomes something neither of them dares to name.

TEMPTATION AND SECRETS

A hand that lingers a little too long.

A confession whispered in the dark.

A line that, once crossed, can never be uncrossed.

Day after day, the space between "just friends" and something far more dangerous disappears. But Jennifer's devoted husband is never far - and neither is the secret that haunts her, the one that taught her that her love destroys everything it touches.

Eric may be the one person reckless enough to prove her wrong… or the next casualty.

TWO BROKEN PEOPLE

Ms Morisson is a mature, character-driven visual novel about desire, guilt, and the terrifying pull of feeling alive again. This isn't a story about escaping a cruel husband - it's about two wounded people who can't stop reaching for each other, no matter the cost.

ABOUT 'THE NEIGHBOR'

This game contains suggestive scenes, mature dialogue, forbidden desire, and sexually charged situations between consenting adults.

All characters are over 18 years old.

No marriages were harmed in the making of this story… though a few may never be the same.
